headline: The Kansas City Federal Reserve has published a paper on the long-term financial risks of the AI building boom, going beyond share valuations.

summary: The Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City has published an economic bulletin titled "Beyond Valuations: Long-Term Financial Risks from the AI Build-Out"; MLex reports that it says the build-out may call for disclosures because of those risks.
